name: George Conway
quote: The humanitarian crisis in Somalia remains dire and millions of people are at risk.

name: Mohamuud Moallim Abdullahi
quote: We urge all partners and donors to support these efforts so that we can act early.

name: Etienne Peterschmitt
quote: Urgent funding is needed to turn early warnings into action.

name: Hameed Nuru
role: WFP Representative and Country Director, Somalia
quote: The support we receive now will determine how many families we can support before the crisis deepens.

name: Sandra Lattouf
quote: Urgent support is needed to help Somali authorities and partners maintain treatment services through the end of the year.

name: Fati N'Zi-Hassane
quote: The upcoming dry season will not just be difficult – it could be the final blow.

name: Hawa Moalim
quote: Since we came, we have received nothing. There is no food, no water, and no proper shelter.

name: Muslima Hussein
quote: Everything changed when we missed the rains. Now we have nothing.
